console.firmware_observation_note: Firmware was not re-queried during this capture. The 2026-10-26 PTP observation recorded 23.0.1.

connection.monitor_mode_note: The interface was set to type monitor and captured 269 frames during a channel-hopping run. A separate 20-frame capture also succeeded.

commands.command: iw phy phy1 info | sed -n '/Supported interface modes/,/Band 1/p'
ip link set <monitor-interface> down; iw dev <monitor-interface> set type monitor; ip link set <monitor-interface> up

commands.result: 269 packets captured; 0 packets dropped by kernel; capture hopped channels 1, 6, and 11 for about 22 seconds
64 advertisement frames; 1 unique network; plaintext NetworkId header parsed

interpretation: The retail console advertises a Dragon Ball FighterZ LDN network whose plaintext NetworkId header is readable without keys. The owner-provided prod.keys decrypt the full advertisement and validate its SHA-256, confirming that the room uses security mode 1 (prod/encrypted) with the challenge enabled, channel 1, max 2 participants, and app version 26. This confirms the passive half of the LDN path and the key compatibility with the target firmware. It does not show that the console will accept a PC-hosted network, and it is not evidence of a parser vulnerability.
limitations: Passive capture only. No LDN frames were transmitted to the console.
The keys are from the owner's other modded Switch, not from the target. The target remains unmodified.
The firmware dump's version is owner-reported and folder-named 23.0.1; it was not independently verified with a firmware tool.
Only one game and one network were captured.
Firmware was not re-queried during this run.
The capture hopped channels, so the per-channel frame counts are not a complete channel survey.
The unredacted pcap and JSON are local-only because they contain the console MAC and SSID.
The key file matches the LDN key derivation but stops at key generation 0x14; it does not cover the 23.0.1 NCA key generation (E-083).
redactions: Monitor interface name redacted because it is derived from the adapter MAC.
Serial number reduced to the three-character prefix XTJ.
Key material, server random, and application data are not recorded.

key_check.method: kinnay/LDN AdvertisementFrame.decode with KeyDerivation(protocol=1) over the local pcap
key_check.key_source: owner-provided prod.keys dump from the owner's other modded Switch; local-only and excluded from version control
key_check.note: The keys match the target firmware's LDN key derivation. The decrypted fields confirm the retail room is encrypted, not a development mode. SSID, MAC addresses, server random, and application data are not recorded.
